negative: no readable text, no logos other than the brand, no other products, no extra people

stitch.captions: burned from the script on-screen text

_notes.durationSeconds: What the tool is asked for and what the beat actually is. A whole number from 4 to 15. write-script floors beats at 4 s so these are the same number.
_notes.headroom: Hook clip only (the first in stitch.order), on its video item: {"askSec": 5, "inSec": 0.5, "useSec": 4}. askSec is the beat length plus 1 s, 4 to 15, and equals durationSeconds, so the quote and the generation match. The stitch starts inSec in and keeps useSec (the beat length).
_notes.characters: Only for a talkingCharacter deliverable: [{"id": "MINA", "description": "", "voice": "one voice description, pasted verbatim into every prompt where she speaks"}].
_notes.dialogue: Only for a talkingCharacter deliverable, on a video item that speaks: {"character": "MINA", "line": "..."}. The line and the voice go in the prompt and generateAudio stays true; a silent beat has no dialogue.
_notes.credits: Images are 1 each. Video is null until estimate_video_job returns a quote; the concept approval's maxSpendCredits is the ceiling.
